sources.title: Managing Forms in Collect
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current ODK Docs page at access; not pinned to a Collect release.
sources.locator: Draft/finalize sections, lines 137-150; send finalized forms lines 164-178.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of official ODK documentation; no form created or submitted.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Drafts may be edited. Offline finalized forms wait in Ready to send and are not editable by default; a form definition can permit edits. Bulk finalization cannot be undone and is incompatible with submission encryption.
sources.applicability: Supports offline states and makes post-finalize correction an explicit configuration decision.

retained_author_recheck.observation: Editing finalized/sent submissions was added in Collect v2025.2.0/Central v2025.1.4; it is off by default, requires client_editable=true, applies only while the submission remains on the device, uses the original form version, appears in Central activity, and manually sent edits must be sent in order.
retained_author_recheck.condition_and_applicability: This documents a configurable native edit path, not a charity-owned correction event ID or immutable before-image. Exact behavior must be accepted only after the pinned build is exercised.
retained_author_recheck.observed_operation: Read-only web.open of the exact official source URL by the retained investigator after intake; no app/product operation or code execution.

sources.title: Managing Submissions in Central
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current ODK Docs page; review states identified as available since Central v1.2.
sources.locator: IDs/attachment status lines 180-188; CSV ZIP/media/OData lines 201-241; review states/edit history lines 291-317.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of official ODK documentation; no Central instance used.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Received is the incoming default; edits become Edited; Has Issues/Approved/Rejected are staff-assigned and do not automatically affect exports. CSV ZIP carries root/repeat tables and per-instance media; OData is live but media must be fetched. Web edits create a new version; change comments are optional.
sources.applicability: Useful review/export base, but custom duplicate/correction semantics remain necessary.

retained_author_recheck.observation: A web edit creates a new submission version and activity; the page says prior versions will be viewable in a future Central version. Activity shows differences but does not necessarily record exact actions.
retained_author_recheck.condition_and_applicability: Do not assume the selected current deployment exposes a retrievable original answer and attachment before-image. Test recovery before enabling a native edit as a canonical correction path.

sources.title: Editing and deleting Kobo data
sources.released_version_or_commit: Kobo help article last updated 2026-05-06; server build unstated.
sources.locator: Individual editing and metadata effects, lines 15-61; further troubleshooting below.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of official KoboToolbox documentation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Web-form edits use the latest form and can recalculate/delete values. Raw edits bypass logic, cannot be undone, and should be tracked externally. Both update _uuid; rootUuid and _submission_time remain. Deletion is permanent.
sources.applicability: Correction requires before-image, reason, actor, and form-version care; native edits are not immutable event history.

retained_author_recheck.locator: Editing and deleting your data, lines 10-13, 19-27, 40-61, 122-131.
retained_author_recheck.observation: KoboCollect submissions cannot be edited in the app after submission. Web edits use current form logic and can recalculate or remove responses; raw edits bypass logic, cannot be undone, and documentation recommends an external log. Project owners can assign separate view/edit/validate/delete permissions.
retained_author_recheck.condition_and_applicability: Neither route alone promises the charity's distinct correction_id or an immutable before-image. Preserve those separately and configure access deliberately.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: XLSX is recommended for repeat groups; CSV suits data management; media is a separate ZIP. Legacy XLS/CSV exporters are slated for removal.

retained_author_recheck.locator: Exporting and downloading your data, lines 28-40 and 67-74.
retained_author_recheck.observation: Standard XLS is an .xlsx file recommended for repeats; CSV omits repeat data and media is a separate ZIP. Excel time formats do not support timezone values; XLS drops timezone data unless dates are exported as text.
retained_author_recheck.condition_and_applicability: If Kobo XLS is selected for repeat groups, choose dates as text and test raw time/offset preservation through export and restore. No export was generated in this research.

sources.title: Apache CouchDB 3.5.1 replication and conflict model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB documentation for version 3.5.1.
sources.locator: Conflict winner/visibility/resolution, sections 2.3.1–2.3.4; page lines 51-135.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of version-pinned Apache docs; no database used.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent edits may remain as conflict leaves, but normal reads show one deterministic winner; caller must request conflict details. Apps must display or resolve leaves. A stale revision write to one node returns 409.
sources.applicability: Sync/conflict analogue, not a complete survey product or authority for auto-selecting the charity's current view.

sources.title: ODK Central issue #1612 with backend attachment-purge test code
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue opened 2026-01-20 and closed with linked getodk/central-backend#1754; no release tag stated on issue.
sources.locator: Issue condition and test-code introduction lines 172-178; code posts a new deprecatedID/instanceID version and checks attachment/blob counts lines 213-263.
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of official ODK Central public issue; inspected test code rendered in issue body, did not run the test or clone/execute source.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The embedded regression test shows a submission edit carrying blobs forward to a new submission definition. Clearing an attachment from one version does not reclaim the blob while another revision references it; purge behavior depends on which version is current.
sources.applicability: A bounded source-code/test example that attachment/version retention can affect storage. It supports planning media retention/export and preserving version lineage; it does not justify remote deletion and does not establish current product validation.
